question: Which versions of this expression set exist, and which is active?

steps.name: versions
steps.soql: SELECT ApiName, VersionNumber, IsActive, Rank, StartDateTime, EndDateTime, LastModifiedDate FROM ExpressionSetVersion WHERE ExpressionSet.ApiName = '{name}' ORDER BY VersionNumber DESC

traps: New versions are their own records; the parent expression set date does not move when one is added.
